title: A Branch from Jesse
old_p1: Isaiah was a prophet, a man who speaks for Heavenly Father. He lived long before Jesus was born.
Isaiah talked about a tree stump, what is left when a tree is cut down. It looks all done. But a new branch would grow from its roots!
Jesse was King David’s father. The new branch meant Someone special would come from their family.
old_p2: Isaiah said the Spirit of the Lord would be with Him. That means Heavenly Father’s quiet help would make Him wise. Years later, an angel, a messenger from Heavenly Father, told Mary, “You will have a son. Call Him Jesus. He will be King, like David.” Isaiah was talking about Jesus!
Jesus is that little Branch, and He grew up to be our King. Heavenly Father sent Him because He loves you.
p1: Long before Jesus was born, Isaiah told what Heavenly Father showed him. He talked about an old tree stump.
A stump looks all done. But Isaiah said a little new branch would grow out of its roots!
The stump was a picture of Jesse’s family. Jesse was King David’s father. Someone special would grow from their family, like that new branch.
p2: Isaiah said the Spirit of the Lord would rest on Him, making Him wise. Years later, an angel told Mary, “You will have a son. Call Him Jesus.” The angel said He would be King, like David. Isaiah was talking about Jesus!
Jesus is that little Branch. Tonight, think of a tiny green shoot. With Jesus, good things can always grow again.
